description: This file contains custom metric functions for object detection evaluation, including functions to compute average precision per class and related metrics, based on YOLOv3 utils.

methods.name: ap_per_class
methods.description: Computes average precision, recall, and other metrics per class based on true positives, confidence scores, predicted classes, and target classes.

methods.name: compute_ap
methods.description: Calculates average precision from recall and precision curves, including the area under the curve.
